search_parameters.q: What is the current RBI repo rate?

response.header: The current RBI repo rate is 5.50%, last raised by 25 basis points on 7 October 2026.

text_blocks.snippet: Direct answer: The repo rate stands at 5.50%, according to the latest Monetary Policy Committee decision on 7 October 2026 .

list.snippet: Change: +25 basis points at the October 7, 2026 MPC meeting 1

text_blocks.snippet: The RBI’s National Summary Data page lists the Policy Repo Rate at 5.25% for dates up to 2 October 2026 Reserve Bank of India . The independent source (IndiaInflation.com) reflects the updated post‑MPC rate of 5.50% as of 7 October 2026 . Because the RBI’s own site has not yet published the post‑October update in the dataset provided, the most recent MPC decision is the authoritative indicator of the current rate.

The repo rate is the interest rate at which the Reserve Bank of India lends overnight funds to banks against government securities. It is the RBI’s primary tool for controlling liquidity and inflation.
